# D-NNN · <Decision in one line, stated as what was chosen>

**Status** Proposed / Accepted / Superseded by D-NNN
**Date** YYYY-MM-DD
**Where** `app/...` — link the module or doc this affects

> Append the finished entry to [11-decisions](../11-decisions.md). Write one when
> a choice is expensive to reverse or when the next person would reasonably make
> the opposite choice. Skip it for anything obvious.

## Context

What forced a decision. The constraint, the failure, or the ambiguity — enough
that someone reading this in a year understands the pressure without having been
there. Facts rather than opinions.

## Decision

What was chosen, stated plainly and in the present tense. One paragraph.

## Why not the alternatives

The options that were genuinely considered, and what ruled each one out. This is
the most valuable section: it is what stops the same option being re-proposed
every six months.

| Alternative | Ruled out because |
|-------------|-------------------|
| | |

## Trade-off

What this costs. Every real decision costs something, and naming it is what makes
the entry trustworthy.

## Revisit when

The condition that should trigger a re-examination — a threshold, a platform
count, a failure rate. Without one, a decision quietly becomes permanent.
